svg.text: M172 compact kitchen / dining constraint screen
Documented target envelopes only; no room adjacency or selected layout is implied.
Coupled kitchen screen: 12 ft 6 in appliance run x 13 ft 6 in counter/island/half-wall section.
14-ft axis orientation: section fits by 6 in; run misses the other axis by 6 in.
Rotated: run fits by 18 in; section misses the other axis by 18 in.
Dining minimum table envelope fits with 12 in short-axis reserve; preferred envelope does not. Route remains untested.
Schematic illustration of target rectangles only; not a coordinated plan or construction geometry.
